card.name: Particles after check, follow, carry, weigh
card.fires_on: The small particle (in, on, back) right after a verb such as check, follow, carry, weigh or catch. It marks phrasal verbs like "check in", "follow on Twitter" and "weigh in".

modes.label: Check/weigh in
modes.description: The particle "in" after check or weigh, meaning to report or give an opinion.
modes.example: checking<< in>> with the team and catching up with some

modes.label: Follow/carry/catch on
modes.description: The particle "on" after follow, carry or catch, as in following on social media or carrying on.

modes.label: Check back
modes.description: The particle "back" after checking, meaning to return later.
modes.example: We also recommend checking<< back>> regularly.
